title: The Arrow Pointing Toward March
skyStory: The moon gallops into Sagittarius at fifty-six percent, the archer drawing its bow and aiming straight at March. Sagittarius is optimistic, adventurous and slightly reckless, and it has heard rumours of an equinox birthday coming up. The arrow flies across the sky and lands somewhere near the cabin. Mars cheers. Saturn checks the date on the calendar twice.

reading: March is around the corner, and with it, your birthday on the equinox. The Sagittarius moon is already planning a party. You will feel restless and hopeful today, like someone who just spotted the first robin of spring, even though there is still a foot of snow outside.

Use that energy to plan something fun for next month, something that has nothing to do with work. A day trip, a new skill, a small adventure. The [[Knight of Wands]] says one adventure, not twelve. Pick it, name it, and put it on the calendar in red.
joel.mission: Plan one fun thing for March today and write it on your calendar in red ink.
joel.omen: An arrow drawn in the snow or painted on a wall. Your next adventure is pointing straight at you.
joel.elementWhy: Sagittarius is a fire sign too

reading: The archer moon is optimistic, and some of that optimism is about to land in your lap. You will hear good news today, small but warm, like a letter from an old friend or a plan that finally comes together.

In the afternoon, you will feel like going somewhere. Maybe the shore, to look at the ice along the water's edge. Maybe just around the block. Go. The [[Six of Swords]] is sailing on, and today the water is a little clearer, a little closer to the other side. Spring is out there.
nancy.mission: Go for a short walk today with no destination in mind and see where the arrow takes you.
nancy.omen: A bird flying north overhead. It means spring is sending scouts.
nancy.stoneWhy: bright and clear for good news

together.text: Each of you suggests one small adventure the other should try in March. Something new but doable: a different walk, a new song, a strange museum. Accept the dare without negotiation. The archer is already aiming, and it never misses a friend.

game.intro: The arrow points toward March and the moon is in Sagittarius, bow drawn. Saturn wants your bravest plan.
game.prompt: Something you're bravely planning to try once March arrives.
